snippet.title: Stickility - Steam Page Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam Page - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3419140/Stickility/

Welcome to Stickility, a 2D metroidvania game with crafting elements, where as a stickman nicknamed "Axel", you'll explore vast and deep interiors of Biotec, a massive underground research center filled with creative foes, bosses, npc's, and more. Find the burrowed truth, and close this place once and for all.

Inspired by famous indie titles, like Hollow Knight, Crowsworn, HAAK, and more.

Official Discord server - https://discord.gg/ttQPJCdFFJ
